audit.why: FAVOURED 4/10 fits: Brand is immobile with a conditional stun; Talon dictates trades and roams freely. Level chart (Talon all 7) matches packet and both layers agree.
Spikes grounded: lvl 3-5 kill window on Sear cooldown, lvl 6 R, first item, late caution vs blaze detonation. Four spikes present.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] claimed R invisibility 'dodges Pillar of Flame (W)' — Pillar is ground-targeted AoE and lands regardless of stealth; the ability invisibility actually denies is Conflagration (E), which is unit-targeted per Riot's text. wants.foe[2] said Brand peels 'with W stun' — his stun is Q (Sear); W has no stun. breakdown.cooldowns had no digits and two Do/Don't bullets were pasted tradeGood/tradeBad.
audit.why: Brand E text: 'conjures a powerful blast at his target' — targeted, so losing targetability/vision breaks it. Q text: 'If the target is ablaze, Sear will stun.' Cooldowns from kit: Q 8s, W 10s, E 13s, R 100s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: spikes[1] now says invisibility breaks his Conflagration target; wants.foe[2] now names Q; cooldowns field carries real numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: No durations in the punishable-cooldown field.
audit.why: Fixed in breakdown.cooldowns edit with Q 8s / W 10s / E 13s / R 100s.

edits.before: - Brand Sear (Stun): matchup-defining — Q only stuns when you are ablaze — after eating W or E, the stun line is the dodge that matters. Check it before every step-up. - E Assassin's Path is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Brand Sear: 8s at rank 1, and it only stuns while you are ablaze — after eating W (10s) or E (13s), the stun line is the dodge that matters. - Pyroclasm runs 100s: while it's down his kill threat is one stun short. - Your R answers fights, not waves.

edits.before: W on the contact, Q the gap, auto for the bleed, walk through the return — three stacks of rent he paid for one trade.
edits.after: Once his W-E setup is spent he has a 10s window with nothing to stun off — Q-leap in then and string the bleed for free.

edits.before: Q-leaping into a held CC for style — Talon without the gap-closer is a roamer stuck in traffic.
edits.after: Committing while ablaze is how Sear stuns land — let the fire tick out before you Q-leap the all-in.

edits.before: R Shadow Assault gives you invisibility mid-combo, breaking his target lock and letting you dodge his Pillar of Flame (W); re-emerge behind him and the passive bleed finishes before he can Pyroclasm.
edits.after: R Shadow Assault gives you invisibility mid-combo, breaking the target for his Conflagration (E) and blurring his stun line; re-emerge behind him and the passive bleed finishes before Pyroclasm bounces.

edits.before: Peel with W stun in a teamfight
edits.after: Peel with a Q stun in teamfights

notes: Level chart consistent across layers and packet (Talon x7) — no chart edits. whys[4] also claims R 'dodges Pillar of Flame'; Pillar still hits the area, but the sentence's core (breaking target lock) is defensible for E and the length band plus the whys entry count made a safe rewrite marginal — flagged here rather than edited. sectionsMissing: breakdown.carry, breakdown.late, ahead, breakdown.early/mid read as owner-side templates shared across enemies; nothing Brand-specific to ground without inventing.
